notes: Corrected the head of s010 οἵτινες → 'men who' from the relativizer to 'men'. Rule 77 splits on whether the supplied word has content of its own: its bare-antecedent list is wholly pronominal ('he whom', 'him whom', 'him of whom', 'that which'), while a supplied generic noun is the nominal the relative substantivizes and takes the head, fifteen corpus units to four. 'men' is a generic noun of the 'things' type, not a pronoun or determiner, so the earlier classification of it as a bare antecedent misapplied that test.
Edges are unchanged; only the target head of that one unit moved. s008 and s013 are the same root rendered twice and each keeps its own English.
